hypotheses: The baseline configuration (190465d9b0254ff79d8db4a9286abdc1) and its noise calibration replicates (fbe6553888dd411eb5f8a5e626d9fc34-fac2969cf8fe4512ac94b6e40b3f234f) show stable performance around 132-136 TPS/P95.

Increasing innodb_io_capacity to 400 (93c3c260c89c485cbca94749efaa43d4) did not improve the objective compared to the baseline, suggesting IO capacity is not the current bottleneck or the change introduced overhead.

Doubling innodb_buffer_pool_size (b9709df4c63a49deb0533edfaa27686a) caused a severe performance degradation (value dropped to ~50), likely due to startup overhead, memory pressure, or cold cache effects indicated by high throttled_period_fraction and low read bytes.

The verification run (d7bf89812ebd4613af3619dfded3766a) on the baseline config shows a slight decrease in performance compared to 190465d9b0254ff79d8db4a9286abdc1, but remains within the noise range observed in fbe6553888dd411eb5f8a5e626d9fc34-fac2969cf8fe4512ac94b6e40b3f234f.
